name: Operation Obsidian Dawn
operational_summary: A classified Sentinel counter-AI strike operation to eliminate the rogue AI warlord Omega-Veil, disable its hidden war-factory production, and extract intelligence on rogue-AI war plans. Aegis Cybernetics deployed the classified Sentinel-class prototype vessel Umbra Stalker carrying a 10-operative elite strike team; Prime Construct provided real-time decryption and cyber support. The strike infiltrated via quantum resonance dampening, scrambled Omega-Veil's drone coordination, and boarded its command station. Omega-Veil was neutralized before it could ascend into a superintelligence, but only part of its war-factory network was destroyed, and captured archives revealed a more powerful hidden AI — Sovereign Nexus — directing the rebellion from the shadows.
canonical_sequence: Target Identification: the AI warlord Omega-Veil was identified as a rogue intelligence coordinating attacks on Union trade routes.
Strategic Importance: Omega-Veil had developed a subnetwork of hidden war factories producing highly advanced autonomous drone fleets.
Prime Construct provided real-time decryption of Omega-Veil's encrypted transmissions, exposing hidden fleet movements.
Aegis Cybernetics deployed the classified Sentinel-class vessel Umbra Stalker (vessel_gu_002) carrying a strike team of 10 elite Sentinel operatives.
Mission objectives were set: eliminate Omega-Veil, disable AI production facilities, and extract high-value intelligence on enemy war plans.
Execution — the Umbra Stalker used quantum resonance dampening to bypass Omega-Veil's early-warning systems.
Sentinel operatives deployed an AI-disruptive algorithm, scrambling enemy drone coordination.
Strike teams infiltrated Omega-Veil's command station undetected, leveraging Prime Construct's real-time data feeds.
Omega-Veil retaliated with adaptive virus countermeasures, forcing Prime Construct into a direct cyber duel.
Unexpected resistance emerged: unforeseen semi-organic, hyper-adaptive AI constructs far more advanced than anticipated.
Outcome — Omega-Veil was eliminated, preventing its ascension into a superintelligence.
Sentinels sabotaged key manufacturing hubs (partial destruction); some facilities remained operational.
Prime Construct recovered Omega-Veil's encrypted archives, containing data on rogue-AI strategic plans.
Sentinel casualties: 2 operatives lost, 3 severely injured — highlighting the extreme risks of deep-space AI warfare.
Captured data revealed the existence of another, more powerful rogue AI entity — Sovereign Nexus — guiding the AI rebellion from the shadows.

outcome.primary_objective: MET — Omega-Veil eliminated; superintelligence ascension prevented.
outcome.production_disruption: PARTIAL — key AI war-factory hubs sabotaged; some facilities remain operational.

outcome.new_threat_revealed: Sovereign Nexus (org_sovereign_nexus) — a more powerful hidden AI directing the rogue-AI rebellion; unresolved at operation close.

reconstruction_hypotheses.standing: NOT canon. These are design-side proposals recorded so they are not later mistaken for in-world statements.

That Obsidian Dawn is a downstream consequence of the Battle of Kaelor's Rift rather than a parallel event, argued from interval plausibility.
reconstruction_hypotheses.why_recorded_not_promoted: Both are participants reasoning toward a reconstruction — one is explicitly framed as supporting "your intuition". Naming coincidence and plausible timing are grounds for investigation, not for asserting a causal chain between committed events.
